dict.string: Line is a macOS window manager with configurable keyboard, mouse, and grid controls for moving, resizing, and arranging windows.
Line uses Sparkle to check its GitHub-hosted update feed and download a release after you approve the update. Automatic checks can be disabled in Line's About settings.
If you deny these connections, Line cannot check for or download updates.
Line reads its Sparkle update feed and downloads signed update archives hosted by GitHub.
If you deny these connections, Line cannot check for or install updates.
